fields.note: P3's account has no cold screen: SiC/PBO/sleeve CTE mismatch and the PBO film at low temperature are unscreened, so its band is open on the cold side. Its dry-cavity humidity limit tightens as the film gets colder (052), shortening the ground interval on cold days.
